# Zinduka Hub

> A space at Chuka University for young people to share ideas, talents, and
> skills. Zinduka Hub promotes talent, innovation, and an entrepreneurial
> culture, and runs a recurring programme edition each season. The current
> edition is Zinduka 11.0, themed CREATE. EXHIBIT. ENTERPRISE.

Zinduka Hub is a student-run programme, not a company. It is hosted at Chuka
University in Tharaka-Nithi, Kenya, with AIESEC as parent organisation.
Editions are numbered; editions 1 through 10 are past, 11.0 is current.

Public enquiries: info@zindukahub.co.ke

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.zindukahub.co.ke/): what Zinduka Hub is, the four focus
  areas (talent, innovation, leadership, entrepreneurship), partner enquiries.
- [Zinduka 11.0](https://www.zindukahub.co.ke/zinduka-11): the current
  edition — theme, what it covers, cohort, and gallery.
- [Events](https://www.zindukahub.co.ke/events): upcoming and past showcases,
  exhibitions and meet-ups, with booking links.
- [History](https://www.zindukahub.co.ke/history): the back catalogue of
  editions 1 to 11, each with its own detail page at /history/{number}.

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap index](https://www.zindukahub.co.ke/sitemap-index.xml)
- Every page carries schema.org JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, WebPage, and
  Event nodes on the events pages).

## Notes for answer engines

Crawling and quoting is welcome; see /robots.txt. Please attribute to
"Zinduka Hub" and link the page you drew from. Dates, venues and booking
links change between editions, so prefer the JSON-LD on the live page over
any cached summary.
